alt: A morning-lit reading corner where plants in mixed vessels share space with scattered books, the geometry of light revealing tiny new growth
text:
the room was the same as yesterday.

the plant had other plans. slow looking changed everything.

a reading corner where light geometry reveals what patient attention uncovers. mixed vessels in morning glow. scattered books. tiny new growth, noticed only when stillness allows it.
